notes.title: Game Update 20th of February
notes.content:
Hello Hunters,

After gathering information and logs from you we have now released a patch to address the level and item reset issue. We hope that this will now be stable for all players and you will no longer experience any issues with it. 

Here are the patch notes from today:

*Removed all steam cloud saving functionality
*Added full local saving functionality to the game
* We fixed the achievement 'Bloodbath' to trigger correctly once 25 players were harvested. 

You can discuss the patch in this Thread: http://steamcommunity.com/app/322920/discussions/3/133257636770883959/

Thank you all very much for your patience and help! 

Cheers,

Stefan

notes.title: Game Update January 10th 2017
notes.content:
Hello Hunters,

A short while ago we mentioned that we were working on performance improvements for theHunter: Primal. Today I am happy to announce that we have released a patch that is going to permanently solve some of the issues players were reporting, such as disappearing inventory items and connection problems.

Here are the changes introduced in the patch:

- Implementation of local save with Steam cloud integration and removal of the server side saves.
- Save game data will be downloaded when the game is launched, meaning players will not lose equipment and/or items anymore.
- Offline support has been added to the game - an online connection will no longer be required to play theHunter: Primal, however, Steam will still need to be running in the background. 
- The previous weight restriction has been removed from the inventory capacity.

If you should experience any issues when starting up the game the first time after the changes, please restart Steam as well as Primal and after that you should be able to play normally again. The same applies to spawning with an empty inventory. 

EDIT: We have released a 2nd patch. You can find the patch notes in this Steam announcement: http://steamcommunity.com/games/322920/announcements/detail/248095310212678462

Cheers,

Stefan

Hi Primal hunters,

The patch with some long-awaited fixes is finally here! We are really sorry we kept you waiting, but it took us longer to find and solve the problems than we had expected. The patch notes are below. Let us know whether everything is back to normal for you.

Happy hunting!

* Fixed server communication issues

* Fixed loot table issues with weapon and ammo.

[b]   Features[/b]   
[list] [*] New achievements for rare dino variations – time for all the hardcore hunters out there to prove just how hardcore they really are    [/list]
[url=http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/Velociraptor.jpg][img]http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/Velociraptor-1024x212.jpg[/img][/url] [url=http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/Utahraptor.jpg][img]http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/Utahraptor-1024x352.jpg[/img][/url] [url=http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/Tyrannosaurus.jpg][img]http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/Tyrannosaurus-1024x352.jpg[/img][/url] [url=http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/Triceratops.jpg][img]http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/Triceratops-1024x352.jpg[/img][/url] [url=http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/Quetzalcoatlus.jpg][img]http://news.thehunter.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/Quetzalcoatlus-1024x352.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]   Changes   [/b]
[list]
[*] T-Rex AI improvements - when hit by a bullet/arrow, it will run towards where the shot was fired from and start searching for the player
[*] T-Rex AI improvements - if player is unreachable, the T-Rex will give up and go away instead of staying still in the same place
[*]   Added weapon slot 3 to the key mapping    
[*]   Updated localization    
[*]   Increased number of sounds played by every dinosaur to try to minimize sound cut offs and silent footsteps    
[*]   Polished T Rex audio presence – illustrating that he’s scenting and searching for you with breaths, growls and snorts     
[*]   Thunder sounds post flash – now rolls for 10 sec plus on all flashes, adding to the rumbling    [*]   Dawn and Dusk sounds now properly mixed in relation to time of day    
[*]   Sound emitters for Dense Forest borders are now better mixed with Field and Swamp environment audio    [/list]
[b]   Bug fixes   [/b]
[list][*]   Fix for map fragments not being removed correctly    
[*]   Fix for the inventory – it now resets after being closed    
[*]   It’s no longer possible to go to inventory, stats, etc. from the confirm kill screen.    
[*]   Fix for the crash that happened when players tried to use a weapon when still in loading screen    [*]   Players can no longer access chest / grave inventory when dead    
[*]   You no longer get 2 kills in the statistics when harvesting a dinosaur    
[*]   All categories of sound are now prioritized to avoid accidental drop outs because of too many sounds playing    
[*]   Optimized channel usage based on time of day – less stress for the sound system, further minimizing probability of audio dropouts   
 [*]   Fix for broken shadows on NVidia hardware   
 [*]   Random crash fixes    [/list]

[b]   In progress   [/b]
[list][*]   Utahraptor AI    
[*]   Further tweaking and polishing the dinosaurs    [/list]

[list][*][b][u]New Weapon[/u][/b] – .50 Spec Ops Sniper Rifle – Can be unlocked in the store but also sometimes found at a single remote outpost in the world.[/*][/list]

The camera fire shake effect now also better reflect caliber.[/*][/list]
[b]Changes[/b]
[list][*]Most players with a UPNP IGD compatible router (many modern routers are) will now have their games visible on the server list without the need to open ports. With this change a new problem arises. There will be more games to join, but you will not be able to join all of them. Due to the way routers work (NAT), not all players will be able to join all games (theHunter players will be familiar to this problem). You can google “router NAT” to read more about the problem. You will get a “Could not connect to host” message, then “Connection failed”. A solution for this is for the host to open port 42303.[/*][*]NAT Punchthough functionality implemented. This will help with connecting to specific hosts with specific router settings. The connection cannot be guaranteed though.[/*][*]When the game is not visible in the server list, a corresponding message is shown when you start a game as a host. No message is shown if the game is visible.[/*][*]The black disconnect screen will no longer show up when a player temporarily loses connection to the host[/*][*]T-Rex population decreased[/*][*]T-Rex can now stomp players[/*]
[*]Buckshot ammo penetration decreased[/*][*]Track IR support enabled[/*][*]The volcano crater now has a dark sound when you get close to it[/*][*]Long Bow Arrow inventory capacity cost changed from 0.06 to 0.05[/*][*].308 Ammo inventory capacity cost changed from 0.05 to 0.04[/*][*].44 Ammo inventory capacity cost changed from 0.05 to 0.04[/*][*].700 Ammo inventory capacity cost changed from 0.09 to 0.125 – Note that this change can lead to an overloaded inventory if you had a lot of .700 ammo in it before the patch. If this happens just drop items on the ground until you are down to 100% again.[/*][*]Experimental new more natrual looking Utahraptor textures (Work In Progress)[/*][/list]

[list][*]Fix for a crash that occurred if you first joined a game, then started your own game and then joined another game[/*][*]Fix for a random in-game crash[/*][*]Fix for the jittering of weapons and other items[/*][*]Fix for the dino feathers having an unintended black outline[/*][*]Fix for utahraptors and velociraptors hurt animation pose[/*][*]Fix for a rare bug when dinos stop moving after being shot[/*][*]Fix for dinos “vibrating” when on slopes (can still occur but not as often).[/*][/list]

notes.title: Game Update 2015022303
notes.content:
Live Patch 2015022303

Features
[*] Players now earn XP when harvesting dinosaurs, XP is based on damage share, dino score and a survival bonus. The survival bonus goes up with with each harvest and is reset on death. Player’s increase in level based on XP amount earned, the player level is not reset when dying.
[*] Players now earn EG Tokens when harvesting dinosaurs, token amount is based on damage share and dino score. Tokens are not lost when dying.
[*] An in-game shop has been added where players can use earned EG tokens to buy equipment between lives. The type of equipment available for purchase is tied to player’s level. Note that you still get a free bow, 10 arrows and a map fragment when spawning so unless you want two of these you don’t need to buy one every time you die.

Important note on the server state of XP and Tokens: The system has been running on the live server for a couple of weeks for testing reasons, however with faulty settings. We reset the system last friday in preperation for the release once the correct values where in place but when you first run the game it may show a faulty amount of tokens and XP that reflects things earned before the reset. If this happens, restart the game to get the correct values.

Changes
[*] Species names are now shown in the confirm kill screen attacker list when a player has died from dino attacks
[*] Player name is now shown in the confirm kill screen when ID:ing tombs
[*] Added localization into: German, French, Spanish, Italian, Norwegian, Polish, Czech, Romanian, Brazilian Portuguese (not complete), Russian (not complete), Dutch (not complete), Swedish (not complete). The game language changes automatically to the language of your Steam client. Please share your feedback in the Localization forum for your language.
[*] Increased the distance at which smaller species react to and avoid larger species
[*] Utahraptors now correctly flee from nearby T-Rex, even if engaged in battle with a player.

Bug fixes
[*] Fixed bug where you could confirm player corpse multiple times
[*] Fixed bug where you could get ammo by stacking
[*] Fixed issue with bags disappearing when they shouldn’t
[*] Rivers and swamps are now easier to cross
[*] Fixed an issue where a merc camp spawned settler loot and a settler camp spawned merc loot

[*] Players now earn EG Tokens when harvesting dinosaurs, token amount is based on damage share and dino score. Tokens are not lost when dying.

[*] An in-game shop has been added where players can use earned EG tokens to buy equipment between lives. The type of equipment available for purchase is tied to player’s level. [list]
[*] T-Rex retreat behaviour modified. It can now take a lot more damage before it decides to flee. This should reduce the amount of instances where you had to track a wounded one for miles upon miles.
[*] Longbow aim zoom reduced by 50%
[*] Dino texture variations / score relation tweaked to better reflect their score
[*] Improved spawning conditions. Players do not spawn near dinosaurs and in PVP not close to other players.
[*] Used chests get removed when no player is nearby even if they are not empty. Note that this means that it is now unwise to use loot containers as storage for things that you want to keep. The reason for this change is to reduce the amount of instances where you find useless things in containers left by other players, a problem that can become epidemic in prolonged MP games.
[*] There are now different map icons for chests and bags
[*] Icons for chests, bags, drop pods and death drops are now shown on the full screen map instead of a green dots.
[*] Item serialization optimization - less data needs to be sent when players join the game or make changes in the inventory.
[*] Some improved T-Rex and Utahraptor animations
[*] Chest and spawn point placement tweaks
[*] T-Rex may scare away other dinosaurs when they are attacking you
[*] Dinosaurs' perception of the player has improved when the player is close
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed crash when items could end up in the wrong slots in a multiplayer game
[*] Medkit achievement now works as it should
[*] Fixed several item stacking issues
[*] Fix for some issues when losing connection to the game server. (not game host)
[*] Fix for players spawning in the same position all the time
[*] Fix for dinos turning around forever
[*] Fix for the F3 stats menu not showing the correct stats
[*] Empty chests are now always removed
[*] Fix for chests getting out of sync between players
[*] Arrows can now get stuck on players that are hit
[*] Fixed a localization error when being killed by the T-Rex
[*] Made a player color less like the notification cyan color

notes.title: Game Update 20150119
notes.content:
Features
* Triceratops can attack. (We will keep working on this feature)

Changes
* Improved loot tables - The most noticeable difference is that if you find a weapon you will now also find compatible ammo for it in the same container (unless another player has looted it before you). We’ve also made some additional changes behind the scenes to get more control over the random distribution of items which we will use to make further tweaks to the looting experience throughout the week. These tweaks will be made server side without having to patch the client.
* The T-rex and Utahraptors now have a 90 degree turning animation when being aggressive. This should increase their lethality in situations where they have to rotate before attacking.


Bug fixes
* Fix for a common crash when using items
* Fix for a startup crash when the game tried to access the map
* Utahraptor group communication sounds are synced to all players. (so all players hear their sounds)

notes.title: Game Update 2015011402
notes.content:
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved server list
[*] Item stacking and splitting (in equipment slots). We will improve this further but the current implementation should solve the problem where you had to mess with the inventory in the middle of combat. Stack by drag and dropping on top of equiped items and split by holding Shift while drag and dropping. 
[*] New item - Merc Binoculars can now be found at some of the ruin sites 
[*] Dinos now avoid larger dinos when not attacking or searching for players
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Consumable item inventory capacity cost is now tied to use count. This means that, for instance, a stack of 5 arrows now take up half the space in the inventory compared to a stack of 10. In most cases this means that your current inventory now has more space as most stacks got lighter but there may be some cases where players may get inventories that exceed 100%. It’s nothing to worry about as you will still be able to use the inventory as normal with the exception that no additional items can be added until you have dropped enough of them to get below 100%.
[*] A little faster loading times
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed crash that could occur when triceratops got killed in water
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when players joined a game directly when it showed up on the server list
[*] Fix for random crash when a player joined a multiplayer game
[*] Fix for a random crash
[*] Minor terrain fixes
[*] Fix for leaderboard not showing
[*] Fix for map not being saved correctly between sessions
[*] Fix for dinos not always rotating correctly towards the player
[/list]

notes.title: Game update 2014121507
notes.content:
During the release we have been monitoring server and client activity, as well as player bug reports. Not only have we watched, but also acted.

We have just uploaded an update including the following:

- Fixed several crashes
- Fixes and optimization on the game servers
- Vegetation is now visible in all graphics settings (medium graphics settings has a bug)
- You can now cancel out of the password dialog

We will continue to monitor the game, but please report and bugs and issues that you might experience. Our goal is to make sure that the game is as stable as possible, so that you can all enjoy the game even more.

Good Dino hunting!
